CREATE TABLE teacher_onboarding_action_receipt (
    idempotency_key UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    source_message_id UUID NOT NULL,
    source_message_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (source_message_version > 0),
    block_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    action_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    step_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('claimed','applied','completed','rejected')),
    claim_token UUID,
    locked_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    expected_draft_version BIGINT CHECK (expected_draft_version >= 0),
    expected_profile_version BIGINT CHECK (expected_profile_version >= 0),
    result_draft_version BIGINT CHECK (result_draft_version >= 1),
    result_profile_version BIGINT CHECK (result_profile_version >= 0),
    result_status VARCHAR(16) CHECK (result_status IN ('DRAFT','COMPLETED')),
    student_command_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dialog_message_command_id UUID NOT NULL,
    next_message_id UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id)
        REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CHECK ((claim_token IS NULL) = (locked_until IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((expected_draft_version IS NULL) = (expected_profile_version IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((status IN ('claimed','rejected') AND result_draft_version IS NULL AND result_profile_version IS NULL AND result_status IS NULL AND next_message_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
        OR (status = 'applied' AND result_draft_version IS NOT NULL AND result_profile_version IS NOT NULL AND result_status IS NOT NULL AND next_message_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
        OR (status = 'completed' AND result_draft_version IS NOT NULL AND result_profile_version IS NOT NULL AND result_status IS NOT NULL AND next_message_id IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (status IN ('claimed','applied') OR (claim_token IS NULL AND locked_until IS NULL))
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_teacher_onboarding_active_action
    ON teacher_onboarding_action_receipt (student_id, dialog_id)
    WHERE status IN ('claimed','applied');

CREATE INDEX idx_teacher_onboarding_action_student_created
    ON teacher_onboarding_action_receipt (student_id, created_at DESC);
